verdict.rationale: Antigravity is an AI coding agent and IDE, so showing license or public-code matching references for its suggestions is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents code referencing, license attribution, or public-code match detection. Artifacts, code diffs, and review features are adjacent review tools and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
